cause: Context Pack was frozen before development started.
impact: The line has an evidence-bound starting context.
lesson: Freeze the initial context before changing implementation state.

cause: The evaluation recorder passed the provider response on with its content-encoding header after reading the decoded body, so the client decoded it a second time, failed, and the adapter resent requests that had succeeded (three identical requests per step in the pilot).
impact: The first pilot records were invalid and discarded; fixed before the baseline started, verified with 16 distinct request hashes in 16 calls.
lesson: An evaluation instrument is code under test: verify it on a pilot (request counts, hashes) before trusting a round.

cause: The v1.9.0 baseline takes hours and model runs import product code lazily, so implementation edits in the version worktree could leak into baseline tasks.
impact: The baseline runs from a detached checkout of tag v1.9.0 (.worktrees/eval-v190-baseline) with the harness copied in; four tasks already finished in the version worktree before any product change are kept; results go to the version worktree's local/agent-eval.
lesson: Run a long baseline from a pinned checkout so development can continue without contaminating it.

cause: The workflow adapter for iv.gmm and iv.weak_instruments passes the bound exog columns without an intercept, unlike the diagnostics and GLM-extension adapters; the pack oracle tests supply an explicit constant, so the consumer path was never compared with an oracle.
impact: Shipped since the IV-GMM pack was wired into workflows: Agent-run GMM estimates and weak-instrument partial F are wrong on data without a constant column (partial F 6223.5 instead of 170.6 in the baseline task); one baseline task concluded instruments were strong when the true first-stage F is about 4.
lesson: Oracle-test the path the consumer calls, not only the kernel; a kernel test with hand-built design matrices cannot see what the adapter leaves out.

cause: User asked (2026-10-18) to fix the IV workflow intercept failure now, with Stata oracle tests, while the baseline keeps running from the pinned v1.9.0 checkout.
impact: Commit 89357e5f: the IV adapter adds the intercept unless intercept is false or a bound column is constant; partial F, df, HC0 robust Wald F, 2SLS and two-step GMM coefficients match Stata 18 to 1e-9. Baseline comparisons list IV tasks separately because v1.9.0 ran with the bug.
lesson: Oracle-test the path the consumer calls, not only the kernel.

cause: OLS clustered standard errors need a cluster column, but model.genesis forbids entity_col for OLS and OLS model_options have no cluster field, so the Agent cannot cluster an OLS fit by classroom (baseline cluster_rct.specific, the STAR replication). The fix belongs in contracts/model, a protected path of this line reserved for the v1.9.2 inference kernel.
impact: cluster_rct and the STAR replication stay hard for the Agent in v1.9.1 (it can aggregate to cluster means instead); v1.9.2 adds OLS cluster-by-column with CR1/CR2 as part of the inference kernel.
lesson: A capability the Agent cannot name in a workflow does not exist for it, even when the UI form can do it.

cause: The orchestrator wrote each executed operation's whole result record as the model-visible text of its operation_result message; a Kaplan-Meier workflow result was ~450k characters (every curve point and censoring flag) and was resent on every later request and into compaction.
impact: v1.9.1 survival smoke runs reached 230k-580k prompt tokens per call (baseline profile: ~30k fixed); about 4 CNY of the smoke spend. Found from recorded tapes, no new calls.
lesson: Bound every server-written message the model reads, not only tool results; measure request anatomy per message from tapes after each smoke.

cause: Event 07234a72 estimated the cost of the unbounded operation results as about 4 CNY without computing it.
impact: Computed from the four smoke tapes at list prices (0.14/M miss, 0.0028/M hit, 0.28/M output USD): calls over 150k prompt tokens cost 0.32 USD (about 2.3 CNY) of the smoke's 0.42 USD total; the survival tasks alone 0.37 USD.
lesson: Compute spend figures from the tapes before recording them.

cause: On-disk audit found JSON event polling rather than SSE, reset-only core budgets, no startup recovery, and Notebook execution paths with independent admission authority.
impact: M1 background recovery and unified operation acceptance remain open. A persisted turn alone cannot establish safe resume or exactly-once effects.
lesson: Reconcile persisted tool-to-operation identity and cumulative budgets before recovery; preserve legacy HTTP response contracts and domain authority boundaries.

cause: First approved zero-cost M1 batch verified against the existing Agent, Notebook and workflow behavior suite.
impact: 1492 passed, 4 skipped, 100 warnings in 123.79 seconds. This is scoped offline integration, not a full host gate or live Agent acceptance.
lesson: Keep skips explicit: native-containment canary cannot apply its sandbox in this environment; three optional resampling tests require imblearn. Durable storage and provider replay remain distinct from integrated recovery.

cause: Mechanical extraction improves ownership but does not remove the two production files and four implementation locations required by the fixed generic statistical-family extension probe. Baseline was reconstructed after extraction from immutable 4abbeac0.
impact: Fixed probe cost remains 2 to 2 files and 4 to 4 locations; M1 half-touchpoint acceptance remains unmet. No threshold or probe change is authorized by this event.
lesson: Measure the effective live declaration and adapter path before extending architecture; module counts and dynamic registration alone do not prove reduced capability implementation cost.

cause: Cancelling the outer lifecycle task while awaiting asyncio.to_thread cancelled only the await; finally released the domain lease while its native worker still ran and its effect was not bound.
impact: A deterministic blocking-thread test failed at the premature release. The fix shields the entire owned lifecycle, drains effect persistence and domain commit, then releases the lease and re-raises caller cancellation. Focused cancellation/lifecycle/audit group: 25 passed.
lesson: Cancellation of an async wait is not proof of native computation termination. Keep ownership through real completion and bookkeeping; immediate run cancellation and process-restart recovery remain open.

cause: Second approved free M1 batch integrates deterministic Notebook phases in the shared Core, typed admission adapters, append-once recovery, cancellation ownership and explicit headless continuation.
impact: 1542 passed, 4 skipped, 100 warnings in 130.44 seconds. Skips retain the native sandbox canary and three optional imblearn cases. No live provider, judge, held-out, browser or full host gate ran.
lesson: Shared provider progression and local crash-window tests do not establish project-wide execution identity, startup recovery, unified execution or full-analysis replay.

cause: New proposals and plans generate business IDs and timestamps that are included in model-visible messages and later strict requests. A pre-turn copy freezes existing state but cannot freeze newly generated identities.
impact: The strict adapter and headless entry remain separate partial deliveries. Full analysis replay with new computations has not passed; exposing permissive replay flags would hide request differences.
lesson: Replay needs auditable business identity and time at their real owners, plus initial-state and effect verification. Do not remove semantic request fields, replay safety lease clocks, or fall back to a provider.

cause: Candidate perf_1m printed ingest plus OLS at 29.05 seconds, above the approved 8-second objective despite the decimal sample-fingerprint microbenchmark improvement. Remaining end-to-end cost needs profiling.
impact: All fourteen measurements printed within the legacy script budgets, including its 90-second ingest budget; that does not pass the version objective. The time -l wrapper exited 1 after a sandbox-denied sysctl query, so this run has no reliable peak-RSS report or whole-command success claim.
lesson: Keep the 8-second target unchanged. Distinguish exact fingerprint compatibility, isolated function timing, script budgets, end-to-end acceptance and measurement-tool failures. Profile the failing stage rather than rerunning already-passed unrelated budgets.

cause: A single affected-stage profile completed successfully after the end-to-end target miss. Cost remains in point-estimation scalar encoding, automatic statistical evidence, and cold Matplotlib startup under an unwritable default cache.
impact: The 8-second objective is still unmet. Profiled elapsed 45.67 seconds and peak RSS 1805.9 MiB include instrumentation; nested cumulative timings are not independent stage measurements. No protected numerical component was changed.
lesson: Retain input/source hashes, thread settings and cache conditions. Optimize against actual end-to-end evidence while preserving every statistical output; do not broaden this row-ID pilot into a numerical rewrite or hide environment costs.

cause: Invalid operation qualifiers became class-wide rules; malformed rules were ignored and the route converted parse/read failures to empty defaults.
impact: Reject the whole invalid document, including duplicate keys, before provider setup or session writes. Valid decisions and the safety floor stay unchanged. Eight public turn/continue cases plus missing/unreadable/non-file checks passed.
lesson: An invalid permission store is an explicit configuration error, never evidence that no restrictions exist.

cause: Initial invocation metadata used a new Core command even when the server dispatcher already owned a command; an existing dispatch proposal test exposed the mismatch.
impact: Core now reuses the trusted dispatcher command while owning step/call/invocation fields. Original dispatch assertions were retained and passed in the affected regression.
lesson: Reuse the authority owner identity; model parameters and trusted server context are different trust boundaries.

cause: Integrated the prepared-proposal, owned-turn, CLI drain and strict permission-file batch against existing Agent and typed-admission checks.
impact: 1082 passed, 50 warnings, 81.39s; separate ledger/capability/numeric boundary group: 53 passed, 9 warnings, 11.21s. No live provider, held-out, browser or host full-gate execution.
lesson: Affected integration is evidence for this batch, not durable recovery, full replay, milestone completion or release acceptance.
